newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 26.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 26.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were reported open Wednesday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Puerto Penasco were shut to smaller tourism and fishing boats, the ministry said.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Cold front in northwestern region seen dissipating, leaving higher temperatures and clear skies. Winds along northern shores at 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour), while below 19 km/11 miles per hour along the southern coast.
Colder weather expected in northwest gulf region in coming 24 hours, with winds about 10 to 15 knots (19 to 29 km/11 to 17 miles per hour).
Hot and partly cloudy with moderate southeast winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
